mapper.select: SELECT tum.MENU_CODE, tum.MENU_NM, tum.DEPTH, tum.SORT_ORDER, tr.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM, tr.ROLE_GROUP FROM tb_user_menu tum JOIN tb_menu_role tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE tr.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND DEPTH = 1 AND tum.MENU_TYPE = 'MENU_A' ORDER BY tum.SORT_ORDER

SELECT tum.MENU_CODE, tum.MENU_NM, tum.DEPTH, tum.PARENT_CODE, tum.PATH, tum.SORT_ORDER, tr.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM, tr.ROLE_GROUP FROM TB_USER_MENU tum JOIN TB_MENU_ROLE tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE PARENT_CODE IN (SELECT tum.MENU_CODE FROM TB_USER_MENU tum JOIN TB_MENU_ROLE tmr ON tum.MENU_CODE = tmr.MENU_CODE JOIN TB_ROLE tr on tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE DEPTH = 1) AND tr.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode} AND tum.MENU_TYPE = 'MENU_A' ORDER BY tum.SORT_ORDER
SELECT BOARD_CODE, BOARD_NM, USE_ANSWER, USE_COMMENT, USE_NOTICE, USE_SECRET, INSERT_DT FROM TB_COMMON_BOARD ORDER BY INSERT_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMON_BOARD ( BOARD_CODE, BOARD_NM, USE_ANSWER, USE_COMMENT, USE_NOTICE, USE_SECRET, INSERT_DT ) VALUES ( #{boardCode}, #{boardNm}, #{useAnswer}, #{useComment}, #{useNotice}, #{useSecret}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_CODE FROM TB_COMMON_BOARD WHERE BOARD_CODE LIKE 'BOARD_%' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(board_code, 7) AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT BOARD_CODE, BOARD_NM, USE_ANSWER, USE_COMMENT, USE_NOTICE, USE_SECRET FROM TB_COMMON_BOARD WHERE BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}
SELECT tbr.BOARD_CODE, tbr.ROLE_CODE, tbr.BOARDROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM FROM TB_BOARD_ROLE tbr INNER JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tbr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COMMON_BOARD SET BOARD_NM = #{boardNm}, USE_ANSWER = #{useAnswer}, USE_COMMENT = #{useComment}, USE_NOTICE = #{useNotice}, USE_SECRET = #{useSecret} WHERE BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}
mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_CODE, ROLE_NM, USE_YN, ROLE_GROUP, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM TB_ROLE_GROUP trg WHERE trg.ROLE_GROUP = tr.ROLE_GROUP) AS ROLE_GROUP_NM FROM TB_ROLE tr ORDER BY ROLE_GROUP,INSERT_DT

SELECT tum.MENU_CODE, tum.MENU_NM, tum.PARENT_CODE, tum.DEPTH, tum.PATH, tum.SORT_ORDER, tum.USE_YN, tum.MENU_TYPE, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = MENU_TYPE AND tcd.UPPER_CODE = 'MENU_TYPE') AS MENU_TYPE_NM, (SELECT MENU_NM FROM TB_USER_MENU tumt WHERE tumt.MENU_CODE = tum.PARENT_CODE) AS PARENT_NM FROM TB_USER_MENU tum WHERE MENU_CODE = #{menuCode}
SELECT tmr.MENU_CODE, tmr.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM FROM TB_MENU_ROLE tmr LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tmr.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE MENU_CODE = #{menuCode}
SELECT COMMON_CODE, COMMON_CODE_NM, UPPER_CODE FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL WHERE UPPER_CODE = 'MENU_TYPE'
SELECT MAX(MENU_CODE) AS MENU_CODE FROM TB_USER_MENU
SELECT DEPTH FROM TB_USER_MENU WHERE MENU_CODE = #{parentCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER_MENU ( MENU_CODE, MENU_NM, PARENT_CODE, DEPTH, USE_YN, PATH, SORT_ORDER, INSERT_DT, MENU_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{menuCode}, #{menuNm}, #{parentCode}, #{depth}, #{useYn}, #{path}, #{sortOrder}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{menuType} )
mapper.select: SELECT MENU_CODE, MENU_NM, PARENT_CODE, MENU_TYPE, USE_YN, SORT_ORDER, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = MENU_TYPE AND tcd.UPPER_CODE = 'MENU_TYPE') AS MENU_TYPE_NM, DEPTH, PATH FROM TB_USER_MENU WHERE MENU_TYPE = #{menuType} AND DEPTH = 1 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
SELECT MENU_CODE AS PARENT_CODE, MENU_NM AS PARENT_NM FROM TB_USER_MENU WHERE DEPTH = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER_MENU SET MENU_NM = #{menuNm}, PARENT_CODE = #{parentCode}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, DEPTH = #{depth}, PATH = #{path} WHERE MENU_CODE = #{menuCode}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_GENDER, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = USER_GENDER AND tcd.UPPER_CODE = 'USER_GENDER') AS USER_GENDER_NM, USER_BIRTH, PHONE_NUMBER, EMAIL, LOCK_YN, DORMANT_YN, MEMBERSHIP, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = MEMBERSHIP AND tcd.UPPER_CODE = 'MEMBERSHIP') AS MEMBERSHIP_NM, INSERT_DT FROM TB_USER ORDER BY INSERT_DT ASC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER ( USER_ID, USER_PASSWORD, USER_NM, USER_NICKNM, USER_GENDER, USER_BIRTH, PHONE_NUMBER, LOCK_YN, DORMANT_YN, MEMBERSHIP, INSERT_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPassword}, #{userNm}, #{userNm}, #{userGender}, #{userBirth}, #{phoneNumber}, #{lockYn}, #{dormantYn}, #{membership}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
